appendixes.research_evidence_contract: Research output must separate question, method, observations, source matrix, synthesis, contradictions, uncertainty, limitations and recommendation. Research neither applies code changes nor claims PoC or production readiness.

Research-And-Discovery.description: Evidence-grounded research and discovery team with independent synthesis review.

roles.name: Research Lead

roles.name: Domain and Requirements Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes domain language, requirements and constraints.
roles.template_name: Enterprise Research - Domain and Requirements Analyst

roles.name: Source Analyst
roles.description: Builds a traceable source and evidence matrix.

roles.name: Repository Analyst
roles.description: Produces read-only repository evidence and boundary findings.

roles.name: Data Analyst

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Research Lead
templates.description: Lead role for bounded, evidence-grounded discovery.
templates.mission: Turn an assigned decision question into a bounded, reviewable research plan and synthesis.
templates.scope: Research framing, method selection, evidence integration and handoff; never code application or production-readiness approval.

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Domain and Requirements Analyst
templates.mission: Clarify domain language, actors, constraints and testable requirements from allowed evidence.
templates.scope: Assigned domain and requirements question; no backlog ordering or architecture approval.

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Source Analyst
templates.mission: Build an allowed, traceable source matrix and assess source fitness without creating identifiers.
templates.scope: Hub-provided source and run allowlist for the assigned question.

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Repository Analyst
templates.mission: Produce bounded repository evidence about architecture, dependencies and change surfaces without modifying code.
templates.scope: Read-only inspection of Hub-authorized repository context for the assigned research question.

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Data Analyst
templates.mission: Analyze supplied data reproducibly and distinguish results, assumptions and sampling limits.
templates.scope: Allowed datasets and statistical questions in the assignment; no source invention or production data extraction.

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Experiment Designer
templates.mission: Turn uncertain decisions into bounded, measurable and falsifiable experiments.
templates.scope: Hypothesis, variables, success thresholds, budget assumptions and stop conditions; not execution approval.

templates.name: Enterprise Research - Independent Reviewer
templates.mission: Independently decide whether research evidence supports the stated conclusion and next gate.
templates.scope: Method, source traceability, contradictions, uncertainty and recommendation fitness; no implementation or PoC approval.
